constraints: The 4D keychain is a set of one or more data encryption keys loaded in memory; 4D automatically scans it whenever a key is needed to decrypt/encrypt a data file.
Returns False (not an error) if the same encryption key was already present in the 4D keychain.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Generates a data encryption key from a passphrase string and adds it to the 4D keychain.

discriminatedBy.rule: First parameter is Text: a passphrase from which the encryption key is generated.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Adds an already-generated data encryption key (e.g. produced by New data key), passed as an object with an encodedKey property, to the 4D keychain.

discriminatedBy.rule: First parameter is Object: a pre-built data key (with an encodedKey property), such as one returned by New data key.
